title: Channel Islands Marine Safari Adventures
specs: Wildlife viewing including sea lions, cormorants, pelicans, sea gulls, and seasonal birds
Historic 32-foot Radon vessel with handcrafted wood deck and tiki theme
Captain Dave with over 15 years commercial fishing experience and US Coast Guard credentials
Maximum 6 paid passengers per trip; no minimum
includes: Guided tour with information about harbor and wildlife
Use of life jackets in sizes S to XXL+
gap: Exact weight or health restrictions not stated
blurb: Guests board a 32-foot Radon vessel for guided tours of Oxnard's Channel Islands Harbor, viewing waterfront homes, marine wildlife such as sea lions and various sea birds, and points of interest like commercial fishing wharfs and a maritime museum. Tours include day, sunset, night harbor cruises, and a holiday lights tour in December. Captain Dave, with over 15 years of commercial fishing experience and US Coast Guard credentials, leads the tours ensuring safety and a memorable experience.

quotes.author: Krystin
quotes.text: This was so much fun!!!! My sisters and I booked this harbor tour with our Dad to celebrate Father’s Day. Captain Dave showed us all the fun highlights of the Channel Island Harbor. He gave us many tips for other local adventures as well as sharing other fun boat tours he does. The boat was perfect, clean and comfortable! There was plenty of room to set up snacks as we motored through the channel. We will definitely be back, Thank you for such a beautiful trip Captain Dave!

quotes.author: Lee
quotes.text: I have taken two boat tours of the harbor with Captain Dave. Both of them have been excellent. Captain Dave is knowledgeable of the area and gives great insight. He is also extremely accommodating and ensures each customer has an excellent experience. I recommend this tour without any reservation whatsoever. I know without any doubt you will also have a fantastic time. Thank you Captain Dave.

quotes.author: Andrea
quotes.text: Captain Dave was the highlight to our trip to Ventura. We were able to make a last minute booking when most other boats were booked or too expensive. His trip was perfect for our family. We saw lots of birds and sea lions. And his knowledge of the harbor, sea life and fishing made for an interesting tour. He was super friendly and fun. What a great day!

quotes.author: Kevin
quotes.text: BY FAR the BEST romantic experience!!!! Me and my fiancé booked a sunset boat ride for our anniversary and it was the best most intimate experience we’ve had ! Captain Dave makes your experience better by providing blankets, fun facts, & great jokes. If you are ever in the area I recommend 100% booking with Captain Dave !

quotes.author: Tina
quotes.text: Captain Dave was wonderful. He was pleasant and welcoming and had a great personality. He was very knowledgeable of the harbor. He is we ll known by the residents. It was a lovely tour I can’t wait to do again!!

quotes.author: Matthew
quotes.text: We had a great time on this tour during our anniversary. Dave is a great host and this is a fun way to see all of the harbor and learn more about the area. The sea lions playing near the boat was a highlight!
